In 1973, Weldon [20] proposed an ensemble of codes, a code that generalizes Wozencraft ensemble codes. The Weldon ensemble was used by him, and later Shen [15], to construct explicit concatenated codes achieving the Zyablov bound for rates less than 0.3, thus improving upon Justesen codes [10] for low rates.
